_comment: Interface-level design-of-record. pinmap is the binding GPIO contract (spec 8.1). nets lists only the named interface nets and module/IC-level power consumers; passive interconnects (gate-drive R/C, dividers, decoupling) are realized and ERC-checked in Tasks 4-6 and intentionally NOT enumerated here. Reference designators: A1=ESP32 DevKitV1 (its onboard LDO sources +3V3 from +5V at A1.3V3 - there is NO separate 3V3 regulator on this board), U2=LM2576 24V->5V buck, U3=LM7812 24V->12V gate-drive rail, J1=24V input terminal, J2=heater output terminal, J3=MAX31855 module header, J4=OLED module header, SW1=rotary encoder (Device:RotaryEncoder_Switch, pins A/B/C/S1/S2), SW2=start push button (Switch:SW_Push), D1=status LED, Q1=heater MOSFET (pins G/D/S), GATEDRV=two-stage BS170 non-inverting boot-safe gate-drive sub-circuit realized in Task 5 (GATEDRV.IN=logic input from GPIO25, GATEDRV.VCC=+12V supply, GATEDRV.OUT drives Q1.G). The gate drive is deliberately NOT a direct GPIO->Q1.G connection.
